#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-}"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: logs/ not found; nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: backup destination not set" >&2
    echo "backup.sh: set BACKUP_DEST to 'host:path' (ssh) or a local directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ -n "${BACKUP_USER:-}" ]; then
    case "$DEST" in
        *":"*)
            case "$BACKUP_USER" in
                *:*) ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$BACKUP_USER" cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST" ;;
                *)   ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$BACKUP_USER@$DEST" cp "$BUNDLE" "$BUNDLE" ;;
            esac
            ;;
        *) cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/" ;;
    esac
else
    case "$DEST" in
        *":"*) case "$DEST" in
                    ~*) DEST="${HOME}${DEST#"~"}" ;;
                esac
               dest_dir="${DEST%/*}"; [ "$dest_dir" = "$DEST" ] && dest_dir="."
               ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null "$DEST" \
                   "mkdir -p '$dest_dir' && cat > '$BUNDLE'" < "$BUNDLE"
               ;;
        *) mkdir -p "$DEST"; cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/" ;;
    esac
fi

rm -f "$BUNDLE"
echo "backed up logs/ to $DEST (wrote $BUNDLE)"

arguments.command: chmod +x backup.sh && sh -n backup.sh && echo "syntax ok"
